ei.title: Imposing Fines Can Undermine Guilt Permanently
ei.subject: 11월_2021 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Imposing Fines Can Undermine Guilt Permanently

fullPassage: One vivid example of how a market mindset can transform and undermine an institution is given by Dan Ariely in his book Predictably Irrational. He tells the story of a day care center in Israel that decided to fine parents who arrived late to pick up their children, in the hope that this would discourage them from doing so. In fact, the exact opposite happened. Before the imposition of fines, parents felt guilty about arriving late, and guilt was effective in ensuring that only a few did so. Once a fine was introduced, it seems that in the minds of the parents the entire scenario was changed from a social contract to a market one. Essentially, they were paying for the center to look after their children after hours. Some parents thought it worth the price, and the rate of late arrivals increased. Significantly, once the center abandoned the fines and went back to the previous arrangement, late arrivals remained at the high level they had reached during the period of the fines.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:

det.tip: 조동사(would/could/should) + 동사원형: would discourage (O), would discouraging (X)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① transform: 시장 마인드가 제도를 '변형시킬' 수 있다 — 문맥상 적절
② guilty: 벌금 부과 전 부모들은 죄책감을 '느꼈다' — 적절
③ ineffective → effective: 'guilt was effective in ensuring'에서 죄책감이 '효과적'이었다는 문맥. ineffective(비효과적)는 반대 의미 ←정답
④ abandoned: 센터가 벌금을 '폐지했다' — 적절
det.tip: effective(효과적인) ↔ ineffective(비효과적인): 죄책감이 지각을 방지하는 데 효과적이었다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:

③ opposite: 실제로 '정반대' 결과가 나왔다 — 적절
④ increased: 지각률이 '증가했다' — 적절

questions.passage: One vivid example of how a market mindset can transform and undermine an institution is given by Dan Ariely in his book Predictably Irrational. He tells the story of a day care center in Israel that decided to fine parents who arrived late to pick up their children, in the hope that this would discourage them from doing so. In fact, the exact opposite happened. Before the imposition of fines, parents felt guilty about arriving late, and guilt was effective in ensuring that only a few did so. Once a fine was introduced, it seems that in the minds of the parents the entire scenario was changed from a social contract to a market one. Essentially, they were paying for the center to look after their children after hours. Some parents thought it worth the price, and the rate of late arrivals increased. Significantly, once the center abandoned the fines and went back to the previous arrangement, late arrivals remained at the high level they had reached during the period of the fines.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 벌금 도입 이전에 부모들이 지각에 대해 느꼈던 감정을 한 단어로 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 본문: 'parents felt guilty about arriving late, and guilt was effective' — 벌금 이전 부모들이 느꼈던 감정은 죄책감(guilt/guilty)
det.tip: guilt(명사) = 죄책감, guilty(형용사) = 죄책감을 느끼는

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시장 원리 도입이 사회적 규범을 약화시키는 사례
det.analysis:
✅ ① 본문 핵심: 'how a market mindset can transform and undermine an institution' — 시장 마인드가 제도를 훼손하는 사례

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 금전적 제재가 도덕적 동기를 대체하면 영구적으로 되돌리기 어렵다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 본문 요지: 벌금(시장 원리)이 죄책감(도덕적 동기)을 대체 → 벌금 폐지 후에도 원래로 돌아가지 않음(remained at the high level)
❌ ① 벌금이 오히려 역효과를 냈으므로 반대
❌ ② 벌금 전에는 죄책감이 효과적이었음(guilt was effective)
❌ ③ 벌금 폐지 후에도 원래로 돌아가지 않았음(remained)
det.tip: 요지: 시장 원리가 도덕적 동기를 한번 대체하면 영구적

ch: 경제적 보상은 항상 바람직한 행동을 강화한다.
죄책감은 사회 질서 유지에 아무런 역할을 하지 못한다.
벌금이 폐지되면 사람들의 행동은 원래대로 돌아온다.
금전적 제재가 도덕적 동기를 대체하면 영구적으로 되돌리기 어렵다.
